senses.example: La cena es a las nueve.

alternatives.reason: In Spain comida is the main midday meal; in LatAm it can mean dinner, so the sense split matters.
The small meal between lunch and dinner; typical Peninsular schedule.
A fixed festive collocation; useful cultural extension.

notes: Spanish dinner is late, around 21:00-22:00; the example keeps that Peninsular schedule.
